name: Chris
source:
Chris is a slacker who moves to a new city where he is to begin a new part-time job. Completely penniless, he moves in a mansion where three sisters live. The rent is cheap and includes three meals a day. However, he quickly learns he must change his slacker ways.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Popotan_characters#Chris]Wikipedia[/url].]
